topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: My sister and I just found out we've inherited Grandma's house. It's like she left us a piece of her, a place where memories fill every corner. We're already talking about how we can preserve it while making it our own. I can picture us spending holidays there, creating new traditions. The garden alone is a treasure; we've decided to keep it just as she loved it. It’s amazing how this gift feels like more than just a house—it's a connection to her, a way to keep her spirit alive. We can't wait to start planning the next chapter of this wonderful old home.
